cards.lore: Ego is the shield that allows then to cut into a living being. Trained for split-second final-verdicts.
cards.power: THE RADICAL-CUT. Ignores wait-and-see for physical-repair. Fixes mechanical-crash but causes tissue-trauma-debt.

cards.lore: Guardian of the gate. They live in the border-zone between life and death.
cards.power: THE VITAL-HOLD. Keeps the wrestler in a state of grace (sleep). Balances the pain-scale and pressure-stats with invisible vapors.

cards.lore: Mechanical engineering applied to flesh. The blacksmiths of the arena.
cards.power: THE STRUCTURAL-RESET. Uses screws, plates, and hammers to rebuild the skeletal-scaffold. Cares about alignment, not finesse.

cards.lore: Views the body as a biological-computer-network where every wire is sacred.
cards.power: THE MAINFRAME-REPAIR. Works on the brain-bunker and spinal-cables. 1mm of error = total-system-melt.

cards.lore: Scientists of the Ward. Solves matches with Pills-and-Papers rather than Blades-and-Force.
cards.power: The Differential-Storm. Looks at 20 Lab-Decoders to build a Massive-Logic-Chain to find the hidden Antagonist.

cards.lore: The High-Tech-Plumbers of the upper arena.
cards.power: The Pump-Restore. Enters Vessel-Vines with a Catheter-Snake to clear the Clot-Monster. Obsessed with the Rhythm-Graph.

cards.lore: Keepers of the Internal-Ocean. They understand the Invisible-Math of the kidney-filters.
cards.power: The Electrolyte-Balance. Manages the Acid-Base-War. Turns a Sepsis-Storm into a Stable-Match via Dialysis-Magic.

cards.lore: The vital bridge between Biological-Meat and Human-Soul.
cards.power: The Narrative-Rebuild. Ignores Physical-Armor to treat Internal-Software, Daze-Confusion, and Mood-Meltdown.

cards.lore: The actual-heart of the hospital. Without Vigil, the physician-plan collapses into chaos within hours.
cards.power: THE SHIELD-MAINTENANCE. Sees early-warning-signals. Prevents the fall-trap and skin-melt while doctors are away.

cards.lore: Elite-forces. They speak the complex language of pressors-and-waveforms.
cards.power: THE LIFE-SUPPORT-LOCK. Manages the lung-bellows machine. Keeps the wrestler alive when they are 99% dead.

cards.lore: Thrives in the silent-hours. Masters of the quiet-emergency.
cards.power: THE DARK-WATCH. Keeps the arena safe from midnight-crises and sundowning-specters when lights go dim.

cards.lore: The silent partner in surgery. Manages the count to ensure no metal-scraps are left inside the wrestler.
cards.power: THE TOOL-SUPPLY. Knows exactly which blade the titan needs before he asks. Maintains the sterile-sanctuary.

cards.lore: The Oracle of the Basement. Provides visual-truth for the entire hospital.
cards.power: THE SHADOW-READ. Looks at grey-maps to find the hidden-tumor-miner or fracture-line.

cards.lore: The Doctor's Doctor. Provides microscopic-proof that confirms or kills every clinical-guess.
cards.power: THE BIOPSY-VERDICT. Looks at a tissue-scrap to give the final-name. If Patho says malignant-max, the match changes forever.

cards.lore: The Invisible-Engine. Handles the fluid-forensics driving every medical decision.
cards.power: THE NUMBER-GENERATOR. Turns blood-vials into stat-numbers to feed the differential-engine.

cards.lore: Lead Strategist against the invisible-invasion.
cards.power: THE CULTURE-REVEAL. Grows pathogen-punks to find their weakness-stat to choose the right antibiotic-artillery.

cards.lore: Guardians of the Molecular-Arsenal. Ensures the Chemical-Strategy is safe.
cards.power: THE DOSE-SHIELD. Stops the Toxic-Match-Up by checking if two Chemical-Allies will explode. The final check on the Doctor's-Prescription.

cards.lore: Navigates Real-World-Chaos outside the walls. Manages Money-and-Family stats.
cards.power: THE HOME-BRIDGE. Ensures the Wrestler has a Safe-Landing-Zone. Prevents being Trapped-in-the-Ward.

cards.lore: Masters of Movement. Turns Passive-Patients back into Active-Wrestlers.
cards.power: THE GRAVITY-DEFIER. Teaches the Wrestler to Walk-Again after a Bone-Shatter or Stroke-Stall. Prevents Stasis-Collapse.

cards.lore: Deals with Existential-Damage. Provides the Lore that medicine cannot.
cards.power: THE PEACE-BUFF. Provides the Spiritual-Anchor to help the wrestler face the Final-Bell when Mind-Armor is breaking.

cards.lore: The tension between Care and Capital. Answers to the Shareholder-Gods.
cards.power: THE BUDGET-CUT. Can delete an entire Tag-Team or close a Ring to save Tokens. Views the Arena as a Profit-Graph.

cards.lore: The Bureaucratic-Hammer. Turns Human-Wrestlers into Data-Points.
cards.power: THE LENGTH-OF-STAY-SQUEEZE. Pushes Doctors to finish the match faster to clear the Bed-Stat. Obsessed with Throughput.

cards.lore: Marketing-Infiltration. Influences the Match-Strategy with Polished-Narratives.
cards.power: THE PRESCRIPTION-PUSH. Brings Free-Lunches to convince Doctors to use his Chemical-Ally.

cards.lore: The friction in the system. Ensures Every-Penny is accounted for.
cards.power: THE AUTHORIZATION-DELAY. Prevents the High-Tech-Scan until Insurance-Gods give the Golden-Stamp.

cards.lore: The Rookie there to Watch-and-Learn while ignored by Surgical-Alphas.
cards.power: THE PIMPING-TARGET. Gets Pimped on Rare Zebra-Facts. Provides Zero-Decision-Power but Maximum-Effort.

cards.lore: First-Year-Hell. The Gophers surviving on Vending-Machine-Tokens.
cards.power: THE PAPERWORK-SLOG. Does the Scut-Work (Notes, Orders, Calls). Without them, the Hospital-Machine halts.

cards.lore: Middle-Management. They have the Knowledge but not the Final-Sovereignty.
cards.power: THE WARD-MANAGEMENT. Actually runs the Daily-Match, Teaches the Rookies, and Handles the Boss's-Orders.

cards.lore: Final-Level of Training. Over-Qualified and Under-Paid.
cards.power: THE SUPER-CONSULT. Knows everything about one Tiny Sub-Arena. The Sniper waiting to become an Attending.

cards.lore: Electronic-Watchdogs. See the Electrical-Chaos before the Nurse.
cards.power: THE RHYTHM-ALARM. Watches every Heart-Waveform. First to scream V-Fib! across the Intercom-Radio.

cards.lore: Unsung-Heroes. Do the heavy lifting to keep Ward-Dignity intact.
cards.power: THE BASIC-NEEDS-SHIELD. Handles Cleaning, Turning, and Feeding. Touches the Wrestler-Body the most.

cards.lore: The Blood-Vessels of the hospital's logistics.
cards.power: THE ARENA-TRANSFER. Moves the Wrestler from the Ward-Ring to the Radiology-Bunker.

cards.lore: First line of defense against the Invisible-Riot.
cards.power: THE PATHOGEN-WIPE. Kills MRSA-Punks and C-Diff-Demons to reset the Arena-Safety-Stat.

cards.lore: Manages Parent-Anxiety while treating the Child-Wrestler.
cards.power: THE DISTRACTION-MOVE. Uses Bubbles-and-Stickers to perform a Diagnostic-Search on a Crying-Rookie.

cards.lore: Masters of the Silver-Arena. Deals with the Frailty-Stat and Multi-System-Collapse.
cards.power: THE MED-CLEAN-UP. Looks at the 15-Pill-Cocktail and removes Toxic-Saboteurs. Focuses on Function-over-Numbers.

cards.lore: Plumbers of the Upper-and-Lower-Tunnels. They love Bio-Sludge.
cards.power: THE INTERNAL-CAMERA-STRIKE. Sends a Camera-Snake down the Gut-Tunnel to find Bleeding-Ulcer-Percy and Burn-it-Shut.

cards.lore: Obsessed with ABG-Numbers and Pressure-Volume-Loops.
cards.power: THE OXYGEN-OPTIMIZATION. Manages the Ventilator-Machine and the Lung-Sponge. Fights Moni-the-Pneumonia.

cards.lore: Manages Legal-Damage. Goal is Institutional-Survival.
cards.power: THE INCIDENT-REPORT-FREEZE. Locks files during a Mistake-Glitch to Protect-the-Institution from Lawyer-Lions.

cards.lore: Manages Human-Capital and Tag-Team-Drama.
cards.power: THE PERFORMANCE-REVIEW. Ensures everyone follows the Professionalism-Code. Can Eject a wrestler for Conduct-Violations.

cards.lore: Digital-Blood-Supply. Without IT, the Detectives are blind.
cards.power: THE SYSTEM-REBOOT. When Electronic-Health-Scrolls crash, only IT can Restore-the-Data-Flow.

cards.lore: Keep the Mechanical-Wrestlers running. Speak Circuit-and-Silicon.
cards.power: THE GEAR-REPAIR. Fixes the Broken-Ventilator. Ensures High-Tech-Tools don't Backfire during a match.

cards.lore: Foundation of the System. Sees the Whole-Story before it becomes a Crisis-Match.
cards.power: THE REFERRAL-FILTER. Decides if the wrestler needs a Specialist-Elite or just a Lifestyle-Reset.

cards.lore: Medicine in the Wild. Must be creative with limited Tools.
cards.power: THE LIVING-ROOM-REPAIR. Manages Wound-Care and Meds in the patient's Own-Arena without Hospital-Backup.

cards.lore: Future of Access. Breaking the Physical-Walls.
cards.power: THE SCREEN-SCAN. Reaches a Wrestler in a Remote-Desert-Arena through a Digital-Portal to give a Diagnosis-Verdict.

cards.lore: Masters of the End. Protects the Soul-Armor when the Body-Armor is gone.
cards.power: THE FINAL-ROUND-GRACE. Focuses 100% on Comfort-Stats and Pain-Muting. Ensures the Final-Bell is a Quiet-Transition.

cards.lore: Ultimate-Responsibility. Balances the Medical-Soul with the Financial-Machine.
cards.power: THE EXECUTIVE-DECISION. Manages the Boardroom-Barons and Surgical-Alphas. Answers for every Lost-Match.

cards.lore: Intellectual-Pioneer living in the University-Tower, far from the Bedside-Mud.
cards.power: THE GRANT-FUNDING-FLOOD. Brings in Tokens for High-Tech-Experiments. Obsessed with Publish-or-Perish.

cards.lore: Protector of the Medical-Tradition. Keeps the Stay-Fluffy spirit alive.
cards.power: THE CAREER-BUFF. Teaches Rookies to survive Hospital-Politics and the Burnout-Shadow. Provides Hidden-Lore.

cards.lore: The Ancestors. Reminds everyone How-it-Used-to-Be.
cards.power: THE HISTORICAL-INSIGHT. The Living-Library providing the Long-Memory of past Arena-Matches.

cards.lore: The cost of the Infinite-Match. Emotional-Exhaustion that breaks Healer-Armor.
cards.power: THE VIGILANCE-DRAIN. Makes staff Cynical and Numb until they Miss-the-Signal.

cards.lore: The Old-Military-Code. The nemesis of Team-the-Huddle.
cards.power: THE JUNIOR-SILENCE-MOVE. Prevents the Intern from stopping a Mistake-Glitch. Preserves Rank over Patient-Safety.

cards.lore: Legal-Parasite turning the Arena-of-Healing into a Courtroom-of-Fear.
cards.power: THE DEFENSIVE-MEDICINE-PULSE. Forces the ordering of 10 Useless-Tests to Protect-their-Back from a Future-Lawsuit.

cards.lore: The Bureaucratic-Interface meant to help, mutated into a Data-Prison.
cards.power: THE KEYBOARD-LOCK. Forces 8 hours of Typing-at-a-Screen instead of Touching-the-Wrestler-Body.

cards.lore: The Hospital is a tag-team match. If the Surgeon won't listen to the Nurse, the Wrestler dies. Respect the roles, fight the metrics, and stay fluffy!
QUEST RULE: Use the Sovereign-Voice of Vigil-the-Vanguard to call a Huddle-Check before the Titan cuts the Wrong-Leg.
QUEST RULE: Call in Social-the-Exit-Planner to secure a Safe-Landing-Zone when the Metric-Master-Manager demands the Bed-Stat be cleared.
QUEST RULE: Deploy Mentor-the-Wise-Guide to Restore-the-Empathy-Armor when the Resident is Ignoring-the-Crying-Student.
